notes.itemTitle: Pay the Campus France EEF fee
notes.title: EEF payment registered
notes.text: Etudes en France registered your EEF payment this morning and Fitria says the IFI finance team is verifying it, with the receipt downloadable from your EEF account once that clears. Nothing more is owed from your side. - Your VFS booking has nothing left waiting on it now. (Their subject line carried the dossier reference, left out here.)
